etymology.historical_story: Coco has no single recoverable origin without an identified referent. In Pixar's film, Mamá Coco is Miguel's great-grandmother, and family remembrance shapes the story. This supplies a cultural association for that particular title, not an etymology for every occurrence of coco. A person's nickname or a commercial name may have an entirely different history. [Pixar's account](https://www.pixar.com/coco).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看见 Coco，先找它指谁或哪部作品；看见 koko，才联想到马来语的可可。
